new_description: Emitter for the Hideki-pattern fighters the Union flew as pickets and escorts. Good enough against energy fire, and little help against debris and solid shot. Good protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian fighter shields, size for size, it draws the least power, but holds the least energy.

A refit of the Hideki emitter with a larger coil, for the fighters kept at the edge of a battle to pick off stragglers. Good protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian fighter shields, size for size, it recharges the fastest, but draws the most power.

A trial grid built for the Central Command's small strike craft. Hurriedly fitted, and a step above the standard emitter. Good protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian fighter shields, size for size, it is the quickest to come back after being knocked down and draws the least power.

Built after the Union joined the Dominion, on designs shared under the Alliance. It is the best a Cardassian fighter ever carried. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Of the Cardassian fighter shields, size for size, it holds the most energy and covers the widest area, but draws the most power.

Modest generator for the Union's freighters and transports, enough to turn away raiders and little else. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship shields, size for size, it draws the least power and is the lightest, but holds the least energy.

The standard generator of the Union's small patrol craft and escorts. Good protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship shields, size for size, it covers the narrowest area.

The grid carried by Cardassian frigates, the picket ships that kept order over worlds like Bajor. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship shields, size for size, it recharges the fastest and is the quickest to come back after being knocked down, but is the costliest to build.

The Galor-class carried its shield generators in the tail, aft of the hull. Heavy and thorough, it is the backbone of the Cardassian fleet. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds.

The Keldon-class shares the Galor's hull with an extra superstructure, and a stronger grid to match. Its shields take energy fire well. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship shields, size for size, it is the quickest to come back after being knocked down.
Emitters buried in a hardened casing, so the shield can fail without the ship losing the generator. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds.

A wide canopy field thrown over the largest hulls of the Union's fleets, built to cover a whole formation. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship shields, size for size, it is the slowest to come back after being knocked down.

The canopy field of the biggest Cardassian warships. Meant to cover a whole squadron at once. Strong protection against beams and energy fire. Weak against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship shields, size for size, it holds the most energy and covers the widest area, but draws the most power.

A field for the pickets and defence stations that guarded Union worlds. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian platform shields, size for size, it holds the most energy and recharges the fastest, but covers the narrowest area.

A larger field generator for the pickets, with a wider cover and a deeper store of power. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian platform shields, size for size, it is the lightest and the cheapest to build, but holds the least energy.

The regenerative force fields that made the orbital weapon platforms of the Chin'toka system nearly invulnerable to return fire. "Captain, I've just noticed something odd about those platforms." (Garak, DS9: "Tears of the Prophets") Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian platform shields, size for size, it covers the widest area, but draws the most power.

A projector for the pylons of a Nor-pattern station, where the ore processing plant sits. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian station shields, size for size, it draws the least power and is the cheapest to build, but holds the least energy.

The main deflector array of a Cardassian station, built to keep an occupied world's skies under guard. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian station shields, size for size, it has the sturdiest housing, but draws the most power.

The full shield grid of a large Nor-pattern station, covering the ring and all three pylons. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian station shields, size for size, it holds the most energy and is the lightest.

The deflector of the Union's greatest fortress stations, tuned to bounce the heaviest energy fire. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and plasma. Of the Cardassian station shields, size for size, it recharges the fastest and covers the widest area, but is the costliest to build.
